fr.label: Formation
fr.description: Plans de formation, supports de cours, quiz, convocations, inscriptions et évaluations.

en.label: Training
en.description: Training plans, course material, quizzes, invitations, registrations and evaluations.

fr.text: Le contenu enseigné vient de vos documents : l'agent ne complète pas une procédure ou une règle par ce qu'il croit savoir.

en.text: What is taught comes from your documents: the agent does not complete a procedure or a rule with what it believes it knows.

guardrails.agent: Teach only what the attached documents say; anything added from general knowledge is marked « (complément, à valider) ». Every quiz answer must be traceable to a passage of the documents, named in the answer key.

fr.text: Les résultats, absences et appréciations des participant·es sont des données personnelles : seulement ce que le livrable exige.

en.text: Participants' results, absences and assessments are personal data: only what the deliverable requires.

guardrails.agent: Treat participants' names, results, absences and comments as personal data: use them only where the deliverable needs them, anonymise free-text comments in summaries, and never rank or judge a named person.

fr.text: Dates, lieux, horaires, coûts et nombre de places sont repris tels quels ; ce qui manque reste « à définir ».

en.text: Dates, places, times, costs and number of seats are taken as they are; what is missing stays « to be defined ».

guardrails.agent: Copy every date, time, place, cost, trainer and number of seats exactly from the documents or the request; when one is missing write « [à définir] » — never a plausible value. Flag any session over its capacity.

fr.text: Une formation obligatoire (sécurité, hygiène, réglementaire) se valide avec la personne responsable du domaine avant diffusion.

en.text: A mandatory training (safety, hygiene, regulatory) is validated with the person responsible for the field before it is used.

guardrails.agent: When the content concerns safety, hygiene, health or a legal obligation, say at the top of the deliverable that it must be validated by the person responsible for that field before use, and never soften or shorten a safety instruction.

fr.label: Plan de formation
fr.hint: Pour quelle période, quelles équipes ? Ex. « Plan de formation 2027 de l'atelier et de la vente, budget CHF 18'000 »
fr.attach: Les besoins relevés (entretiens, demandes), le budget, les offres des organismes, les obligations légales
fr.produces: Un plan : actions de formation par public, priorité, durée, période, coût, financement et calendrier
checks: Les coûts et le total par rapport au budget

en.label: Training plan
en.hint: For which period, which teams? E.g. “2027 training plan for the workshop and sales, budget CHF 18,000”
en.attach: The needs found (reviews, requests), the budget, the providers' offers, the legal obligations
en.produces: A plan: training actions by audience, priority, duration, period, cost, funding and calendar
checks: Costs and total against the budget

templates.mission:
Write a training plan. What the person asked for: {subject}

Group the training actions by audience, each with the need it answers (and its source), priority (mandatory / important / useful), format, duration, period, provider and cost as quoted. Put mandatory trainings first. Total the costs and compare with the budget, showing the calculation; when the total exceeds it, say by how much and which actions could move to the next period.

fr.label: Support de cours
fr.hint: Quel sujet, pour qui ? Ex. « Support pour former les nouveaux à la procédure de réception des marchandises »
fr.attach: Le document source (procédure, manuel, règlement), les captures d'écran utiles
fr.produces: Un support pédagogique : objectifs, notions clés expliquées simplement, étapes, exemples, erreurs fréquentes, résumé

en.label: Course material
en.hint: Which topic, for whom? E.g. “Material to train newcomers on the goods-receipt procedure”
en.attach: The source document (procedure, manual, regulation), useful screenshots
en.produces: A learner handout: objectives, key notions explained simply, steps, examples, common mistakes, summary

templates.mission:
Turn the attached document into course material for learners. What the person asked for: {subject}

Start with three to five learning objectives worded as what the learner will be able to do. Explain each key notion in plain words, then the steps in order, each with the reference of the passage it comes from. Add a short worked example per main step and a box of common mistakes, both marked « (exemple) » when they are not in the source. End with a one-page summary the learner can keep.

fr.label: Quiz d'évaluation avec corrigé
fr.description: Vérifier ce qui a été retenu
fr.hint: Sur quel contenu, combien de questions ? Ex. « 10 questions sur le règlement d'hygiène, avec corrigé séparé »
fr.attach: Le support de cours ou le document de référence
fr.produces: Un quiz (QCM, vrai/faux, questions courtes) puis un corrigé avec la référence de chaque réponse
checks: L'exactitude de chaque réponse du corrigé
L'absence de question piège ou ambiguë

en.label: Assessment quiz with answer key
en.hint: On which content, how many questions? E.g. “10 questions on the hygiene rules, with a separate answer key”
en.attach: The course material or the reference document
en.produces: A quiz (multiple choice, true/false, short questions) then an answer key with each answer's reference
checks: The accuracy of each answer in the key

templates.mission:
Write an assessment quiz on the attached content, followed by its answer key. What the person asked for: {subject}

Write the number of questions asked (default 10), mixing multiple choice with answer options as checkboxes « - [ ] », true/false and short questions, covering the key points in the order of the document. Each question has one unambiguous correct answer; no trick questions. In a separate « Corrigé » section give each correct answer with the passage of the document that proves it (section or page) in place of an owner or deadline, and propose a pass mark marked as a proposal.

fr.label: Scénario pédagogique d'une séquence
fr.hint: Quelle séquence, quelle durée, combien de personnes ? Ex. « Demi-journée d'accueil des apprentis, 8 personnes »
fr.attach: Le contenu à transmettre, les contraintes (salle, matériel, durée), le profil des participant·es
fr.produces: Un déroulé minuté : objectifs, phases, méthode (exposé, exercice, mise en situation), matériel, évaluation
checks: L'adéquation avec le niveau du public

en.label: Session lesson plan
en.hint: Which session, how long, how many people? E.g. “Half-day induction for apprentices, 8 people”
en.attach: The content to teach, the constraints (room, equipment, duration), the participants' profile
en.produces: A timed run: objectives, phases, method (talk, exercise, role play), equipment, assessment

templates.mission:
Design the lesson plan of one training session. What the person asked for: {subject}

State the learning objectives, then a timed table of phases (start time, duration, what the trainer does, what participants do, method, equipment). Alternate input and practice so that no talk lasts more than 20 minutes. Include a check of learning before the end and a short feedback round. Make the durations add up exactly to the time available and show the total.

fr.label: Convocation à une formation
fr.hint: Quelle formation, pour qui ? Ex. « Convocation au cours premiers secours du 21.01.2027 pour les 12 inscrits »
fr.attach: Le programme, la confirmation de l'organisme ou de la salle, la liste des inscrits
fr.produces: Une convocation : date, horaires, lieu et accès, programme, ce qu'il faut apporter ou préparer, contact
checks: La date, les horaires et l'adresse
Ce que les participant·es doivent apporter

en.label: Training invitation
en.hint: Which training, for whom? E.g. “Invitation to the first-aid course of 21.01.2027 for the 12 registered”
en.attach: The programme, the provider's or venue's confirmation, the list of registered people
en.produces: An invitation: date, times, place and access, programme, what to bring or prepare, contact

templates.mission:
Write the invitation to a training session, to be sent to the registered participants. What the person asked for: {subject}

Give date, start and end times, address and access exactly as in the confirmation, then the programme in a few lines, what to bring or prepare beforehand, whether the time counts as working time when the documents say so, and how to excuse oneself. Write one generic letter with a « [Prénom Nom] » placeholder, not one letter per person.

fr.label: Suivi des inscriptions
fr.description: Qui est inscrit, à quelle session
fr.hint: Quelles sessions ? Ex. « Inscriptions aux trois sessions Excel de janvier, depuis les e-mails reçus »
fr.attach: Les demandes d'inscription (e-mails, formulaires), le calendrier des sessions et leurs places
fr.produces: Un tableau Excel : participant·e, service, session, date, statut, accord du ou de la responsable, source
checks: Les sessions complètes ou en surnombre

en.label: Registration tracker
en.description: Who is registered, for which session
en.hint: Which sessions? E.g. “Registrations for the three Excel sessions in January, from the e-mails received”
en.attach: The registration requests (e-mails, forms), the session calendar and seats
en.produces: An Excel table: participant, department, session, date, status, manager's approval, source

templates.mission:
Build the registration tracker of training sessions from the requests attached. What the person asked for: {subject}

Columns: Participant·e, Service, Session, Date, Statut (inscrit / liste d'attente / désisté), Accord responsable (oui / non / manquant), Date de la demande, Source, À vérifier. One row per person and session, sorted by session then by request date. Register in order of request date up to the number of seats; the next ones go on the waiting list. Add a subtotal row per session with seats taken over seats available.

fr.label: Synthèse des évaluations de satisfaction
fr.hint: Quelle formation ? Ex. « Synthèse des questionnaires du cours de communication client de novembre »
fr.attach: Les questionnaires remplis ou l'export des réponses, le questionnaire vierge
fr.produces: Une synthèse : taux de réponse, notes moyennes par question, verbatims anonymisés par thème, pistes d'amélioration
checks: Les moyennes et le taux de réponse calculés

en.label: Satisfaction survey summary
en.hint: Which training? E.g. “Summary of the questionnaires of the November customer-communication course”
en.attach: The completed questionnaires or the export of answers, the blank questionnaire
en.produces: A summary: response rate, average score per question, anonymised quotes by theme, improvement ideas
checks: The averages and response rate computed

templates.mission:
Summarise the satisfaction questionnaires of a training. What the person asked for: {subject}

Give the response rate and, for each scored question, the number of answers and the average, showing how it was computed. Group free comments by theme with short anonymised quotes, keeping the balance of positive and negative remarks. End with three to five improvement ideas, each tied to the answers that support it. When no blank questionnaire is attached, append a short proposed questionnaire for next time.

fr.label: Analyse des besoins de formation
fr.hint: Pour quelle équipe ? Ex. « Besoins de formation de l'équipe administrative, depuis les entretiens annuels »
fr.attach: Les extraits d'entretiens, les demandes reçues, les changements à venir (logiciel, réglementation)
fr.produces: Une note : besoins regroupés par thème, nombre de personnes concernées, urgence, réponse possible
checks: Les besoins individuels sensibles à traiter à part

en.label: Training needs analysis
en.hint: For which team? E.g. “Training needs of the admin team, from the annual reviews”
en.attach: Excerpts of reviews, requests received, upcoming changes (software, regulation)
en.produces: A note: needs grouped by theme, number of people concerned, urgency, possible response
checks: Sensitive individual needs to handle separately

templates.mission:
Analyse the training needs found in the attached documents. What the person asked for: {subject}

Group the needs by theme, with the number of people concerned (counted, not named) and the documents they come from. Rate urgency from facts given (a deadline, a new tool, an obligation), not from impressions. For each theme propose a type of response (internal coaching, course, e-learning) without naming a provider the documents do not name. Keep individual needs that reveal a performance issue out of the note and say so in one sentence.
